questions2.question2: When do you usually have to come into contact with English?

questions2_answer.question2: I usually come into contact with English when I watch movies, read books, or communicate with friends online. It's also necessary for work and school tasks.

questions3.question3_1: Tell me about your English learning experience?
questions3.question3_2: I can read and write, but I can't speak English. Do you have any advice for me?
questions3.question3_3: English is a popular language in the world. What are your thoughts on this opinion?

questions3_answer.question3_1_answer: My English learning experience has been quite challenging but rewarding. I started with basic grammar and vocabulary, then gradually moved on to speaking and listening practice through movies, books, and conversations.
questions3_answer.question3_2_answer: I suggest practicing speaking regularly, even if it's with yourself or language exchange partners. Listening to English podcasts and mimicking native speakers can help improve pronunciation and fluency in speaking.
questions3_answer.question3_3_answer: I agree that English is a global language. Its widespread use in business, media, and education makes it essential for communication across cultures, providing more opportunities for travel and career advancement.

questions4_main: The english club will organize a talk to attract both old and young people. Please give your opinions.
question4_1_text: Write a short email to your friend (about 50 words).
question4_2_text: Write an email to the president of the club (about 120-150 words).
question4_1_text_answer:
Hi Linh,
I just heard about the talk that the English club is organizing. I think it’s a great idea to attract both young and old people. We could have some interactive activities and maybe a Q&A session. It’ll be fun!
Let me know if you want to join!
Best,
Phuong
question4_2_text_answer:
Dear Club President,
I am excited to hear about the upcoming talk organized by the English club. I think it’s a fantastic way to attract both young and older generations. To ensure the event is engaging for everyone, I suggest including a variety of activities, such as a discussion on current trends or an interactive segment where the audience can participate. It could also be interesting to invite a guest speaker who has experience with English language learning across ages.
I believe this approach will help create a more inclusive atmosphere, attracting diverse audiences. I would be happy to assist in organizing the event or promoting it.
Best regards,
Jimmy
